verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own Inso CLI is built to run unattended in CI: it disables prompts and returns pass/fail exit codes, and it can automate collection runs, tests and spec linting inside Git workflows. That gives real headless automation. However, triggering and scheduling depend on the user's external CI system. Missing for 10: native scheduled or background automations or monitors within Insomnia, agentic or AI-driven autonomous task execution, and independent hands-on corroboration.
